measurementRationale: An initial Triarch test failed the older whole-canvas progression >12 proxy despite faithful restrained motion. Its stationary neutral negative space yields global differences of 9.44/10.32, while fixed 1/16-canvas regions change by 32.20/32.81 and 16.15%/17.40% of normalized samples change by >12. Completion projects therefore use fixed-grid regional amplitude plus changed-area coverage. Frozen references keep the original global threshold. Source fidelity, colour, decoding, seam and poster thresholds are unchanged. Automated temporal variation is not creative approval.

projects.direction: The five white wordmark letterfaces lift independently from their original black silhouette; actual cup and carton peel out, overlap, and settle back into a branded packaging still life.
limitations: Flattened raster originals provide no editable type, independent burger ingredients or packaging dielines. No reconstructed lettering, new food, 3D product simulation or newly attributed deliverables are used.

The five actual white letterfaces are alpha-isolated from the flattened mark. Its shared black silhouette and yellow phrase remain anchored; editable original typography would be required to rig independently complete outlined glyphs.

The 1440×810 canvas is an editorial assembly of native-size/reduced layers, not a 1440px-wide rerendered source logo. Cup remains at or below its approximately300px native visible width; source carton is approximately550px wide.
Product silhouettes use manually reviewed alpha paths. Transparent or motion-blurred editable masters would permit finer physical separation.

projects.direction: The gold annulus and green core separate, counter-turn and reunite; original SOL lettering resolves before its circular geometry opens real signage, notices and stationery.
limitations: The only clean, front-facing, complete emblem in the supplied flat boards is 186×186px. It is never presented larger than 186px in either export.
A native vector emblem / lettering master is required for a larger independently animated identity. No logo has been traced or rebuilt.
The application images are flattened approved mockups, not photographs of verified completed client work; no historical or engagement claims are added.

projects.direction: An illustrated badge opens into actual wordmark, pastry, crest and ribbon layers; source flourishes lead the pieces back into a complete identity beside real packaging.
limitations: Only flattened1654×931 PNG boards are supplied; this is a 2D source-pixel assembly, not editable vector or product3D.
The large source badge is668×718; its on-screen width is at most618px. Packaging crops are255×400 and148×205, not high-resolution product renders.
Chocolate and the pastry are one genuinely connected supplied illustration; they move together to avoid inventing pixels under occlusion.
The original lower ribbon, descriptor and its ornament overlap, so they remain one source layer.

The original AI/SVG/PSD with independent letters, pastry, chocolate, frame and decorative paths is required for letter-by-letter animation without cutting overlapping cream outlines and for resolution-independent export.

projects.direction: Seven authentic letter fragments move on measured vertical axes, align around their original tagline, then establish an architectural framework for an actual paper card and device presentation.
limitations: The originals are two flattened1654×931 presentation PNGs. The tagline occludes the middle of the large logo. Only visible letter fragments are animated; an approved AI/SVG or layered PSD is needed for independent complete glyphs.
Dark letter/monogram pixels are isolated by source-colour mattes; the pale architectural photograph is kept as its own crop rather than inventing a clean background under the original logo.
The main wordmark is720px wide and the monogram crop151×169; both remain at or below native size. The1440×810 canvas does not create new logo detail.
The printed card is a500×372 raster cutout and the device panel554×629. Editable identity geometry, a high-resolution card export and a clean device master would support larger presentation.
No pricing, package descriptions, verified services, client outcomes or new typography are added.

projects.direction: Five original gradient-mark surfaces travel on separate vectors and connect; the two source wordmark phrases align before the same directional rhythm carries real printed cards and a mug into an application composition.
limitations: Three flattened1654×931 PNG presentation boards are supplied. The principal visible mark is approximately486×239px; it is never enlarged above native size in either composition.

Visible overlapping parts can separate, but independently complete hidden underlaps cannot be recovered. An approved layeredAI/SVG with the gradient surfaces and lettering paths is needed for deeper articulation and large identity-only renders.
Printed applications remain flat source cutouts, not new3D product renders, verified launched products or evidence of a functioning software platform.
The original mug handle is clipped at the right presentation-board edge. The new composition preserves that source boundary at the output edge instead of inventing missing material.
High-resolution isolated application exports would improve small printed lettering and physical product edge detail. Existing source copy is never promoted to verified client/team facts.

projects.direction: The real cup lid/body, citrus quarters and leaves spring apart with overlapping timing, then align inside the original gold ring. Actual lettering, fruit photographs, menu artwork and a top-view drink extend the identity into a cohesive application composition.
limitations: All originals are flattened PNGs. The complete badge is522×518, with each central component only about80–160px wide. The identity stays at or below native size.
The gold ring, curved title and paired leaves remain source raster groups. Editable AI/SVG/PSD masters would enable finer path/letter and individual-leaf control.
The top-view drink and straw are one source photographic layer; toppings and hidden cup surfaces cannot be faithfully separated without layered or alpha photographic masters.
The illustrated menu is a real supplied printed-layout panel, not a functioning interface. Its About/Find Us claims are not used in this motion composition.
The810×1080 and1440×810 canvases arrange native-scale artwork; they do not create additional source detail.
